capabilities: paste the latest cliplet or search saved ones
store cliplets in IndexedDB or vault data.json
automatically clean up old unnamed items
extras: README warns that encryption only prevents casual viewing (the key is derived from the plugin's own data.json) and should not protect sensitive data; documents storage-switching and sync pitfalls, a 200-item and 100 KB-per-item limit, and a 60-day cleanup rule for unnamed items.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in clipboard history or snippet storage, and the OS clipboard gets overwritten and is limited on mobile.
summary: Clipboard and snippet manager that stores reusable text and code in an Obsidian-internal history, separate from the OS clipboard.
